name: Sableen Kelwyn
keeps: the names of everyone who came through
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Wrote the Canon of Medicine, which was a standard text in European universities for roughly six hundred years.
text: Sableen kelwyn of the counted step, keeps a door for the 21th tranche, doors 191 to 200. Keeps the names of everyone who came through. Reads Ibn Sina (Avicenna).
